opening: All of this has been going on for two weeks.
Four months ago I had a transplant of both lungs, and it went without complications.
I take prednisone 20 mg every day.
I take mycophenolate mofetil 1000 mg twice a day.

opening.text: I've been dizzy, feeling tired, and weak all over for the past two weeks. I also have trouble walking. Four months ago I had a transplant of both lungs, and it went without complications. I'm currently taking prednisone 20 mg every day and mycophenolate mofetil 1000 mg twice a day.
